title: Addressing error indicator
statement: For Boolean functions $f,g\colon\{−1,1\}^N\to\{−1,1\}$ and an input $x\in\{−1,1\}^N$, define their addressing error indicator to be $1$ if $f(x)\ne g(x)$ and $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean functions $f$ and $g$ on the $N$-dimensional sign cube
